verdict.rationale: A relay or edge proxy is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not mention a relay proxy, self-hosted evaluation service, local flag caching for vendor outages, or keeping SDK traffic inside a private network. The SDK, management API, and MCP server items are about other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run a relay/edge proxy so flags stay served when the vendor is unreachable and SDK traffic stays inside my network
